_doc: Source of truth for the Vibe Appliance console manifest (vendored to Vibe-Appliance/console/manifests/vibe-tx-converter.json). Adds the Vibe Auth single sign-on contract (ADR-027, docs/sso.md). vibe-app.yaml is the legacy boot-handshake manifest and is kept only for that runtime check.
description: Converts bank and credit-card PDF statements into CSV, OFX 2.x, QFX, and QBO Web Connect files for re-import into QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Quicken, and Xero.

optional.name: VIBE_APP_SUBDOMAIN
optional.doc: Operator override for this app's subdomain label. Empty = the manifest default. Consumed by the appliance routing (Caddy vhost + Cloudflare Tunnel CNAME/ingress) when DOMAIN_ROUTING_MODE=subdomain-per-app; ignored in single-host mode. Single DNS label — lowercase letters, digits, dashes, no dots.

ui.label: Subdomain
ui.helpText: The <subdomain> in <subdomain>.<your-domain> for this app when routing is 'subdomain per app' (see Network settings). Leave blank to use the built-in default. Lowercase letters, digits, and dashes; no dots. Saving re-renders routing and re-provisions the Cloudflare Tunnel; the app briefly restarts.

optional.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
optional.doc: Claude API key. Required when LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic (the appliance default for this app). Inherited from appliance.env unless overridden.

ui.label: Anthropic API key
ui.helpText: Required for the AI-assisted extraction path. The appliance-wide key is used unless overridden per-app.

optional.name: ANTHROPIC_MODEL
optional.doc: Claude model used when LLM_PROVIDER=anthropic. Inherited from the appliance Settings → AI selection.

firstLogin.note: First request lands on /register because no users exist; create the admin there.
